note: ⛔ SNG-523. THE SUNK ASSAY, LEVEL 4 — THE ASSAY ITSELF. ⚑ THE FLOOR THE SPEC SEALED AS UNBUILDABLE, AND IT IS BUILDABLE NOW. CCode's SNG-515 §1 read '`projectTicks` does not exist anywhere in the engine' and A2b said 'the dungeon ships as three levels with a sealed floor.' ⚠️ THAT REPLY IS STALE: `engine/projects.js` carries `openProject · tickProject · interruptProject · resumeProject · sabotageProject · inheritProject · tickAllProjects`, all wired in `app.js`, and THREE CRAFTS AUTHOR `projectTicks`. ⚑ AND THE COMMIT COMMENT NAMES THIS ROOM AS THE REASON: app.js:6562 — '`openProject` had no caller, which is why Aevi's Sunk Assay…' ➡️ The spec asked for a system and the system arrived.
_whyNotAFight: ⛔ THERE IS NO OPPONENT ON THIS FLOOR AND THAT IS THE DESIGN. Levels 1–3 were sense, hazard and the fight at maximum. ⚠️ THE ASSAY IS NOT DEFENDED — it is RUNNING, and it has been running since before the flood. ⚑ You do not beat it. You work on it, leave, and come back to find the work still there.
setup: The assay floor is dry, which is the first wrong thing. The water stops at the threshold and does not come in. Beyond it the test-frame is still turning over — slow, patient, and entirely uninterested in you. Something has been measuring this place for a very long time and has not finished.
stakes: ⚑ What the Precursors were TESTING FOR. ⚠️ And whether a thing that has been running since before the flood is dormant, interrupted, or ON SCHEDULE.

project._requires: ⛔ ANY ONE OF THE THREE OPENS IT, AND THEY OPEN DIFFERENT PROJECTS. `sound_read` (mason T1, `projectTicks: true`) reads the frame's LOAD PATH — what carries and what is ornament. `working_model` (cogitant, `projectTicks: "r3"` — ⚠️ RANK-GATED, and `isProjectCraft` reads the rank) holds its true shape where others can turn it. `built_system` (syllogist T3) builds a logic that RUNS WITHOUT YOU. ⚑ A PARTY WITH NONE OF THEM CANNOT OPEN THE FLOOR — which is the first place in the game where a craft nobody brought is a door that stays shut.
project.hands: ⚠️ `tickAllProjects` passes `hands: 1 + party.length` — ⛔ SO THE PARTY IS THE LABOUR. This floor is the one place where bringing people is mechanically the whole answer, and R36 makes them people rather than a headcount.
project._interruptible: ⛔ `interruptProject` AND `resumeProject` BOTH EXIST, AND THIS ROOM IS WHAT THEY ARE FOR. ⚠️ You leave the Assay. You go and do something else for a season. THE WORK IS STILL THERE. ⚑ That is the fiction and the mechanic saying the same thing, which is the whole reason the spec asked for a project level rather than a puzzle.
project.sabotage: ⛔ RESOLVED — THE ASSAY IS INDIFFERENT AND `sabotageProject` IS NOT AUTHORED HERE. ⚠️ It does not defend itself because YOU ARE NOT A THREAT TO A MEASUREMENT — you are inside the sample. ⚑ Which makes the indifference terrible rather than cold, and turns the three floors above it retroactive: everything the party did on the way down was measurable.

completionGrants.what: the Assay is FINISHED — `projectTicks` banked to threshold
completionGrants.why: ⛔ CONDITION 3 OF FOUR. ⚠️ Not read, not surveyed — FINISHED. An instrument mid-measurement will not take instruction; it is busy. ⚑ AND FINISHING IT DOES NOT GIVE A VERDICT: the reporting channel works and THERE IS NO LONGER ANYONE LISTENING — Akinetos dormant, Kenosis a hole, Parakletos distributed and does not receive. ⛔ SO A PARTY THAT FINISHES THE ASSAY GETS THE INSTRUMENT. A measurement with no recipient is a set of controls with nobody's hand on them. ➡️ THAT IS HOW A PERSON COMES TO DIRECT THE SUBSTRATE: not by passing the test, but by being the only one still in the room when it finishes.

_theThreshold: ⚑ `projectThreshold` derives from the craft's own `mechanic.magnitude × ticksPerMagnitude` unless authored. ⬜ NOT OVERRIDDEN HERE — the three crafts carry different magnitudes, so THE FLOOR TAKES LONGER FOR A CRAFT THAT REACHES FURTHER, and that is correct without a dial.

outcomes.what: You learn what the assay measures. ⛔ NOT what it found — what it is FOR. ⚠️ And that it is not a ruin: it is a running instrument with an owner who has not collected.

⚑ The project persists. ⚠️ `tickAllProjects` banks work every pass the party has hands to spare — ⛔ SO A HOLD WITH A KEEPER AND A CREW ADVANCES THIS FLOOR WHILE THE PLAYER IS ELSEWHERE, which joins the dungeon to the holdings economy in the one place either system would want it.
⚠️ Nothing bad happens. ⛔ THE ASSAY GOES ON MEASURING, and that is the unsettling ending rather than the punishing one.

_whatThisTests: ⛔ THE THIRD PAIR THAT HAS NEVER MET. L1 was obscure against opponents who look. L2 is healing against ongoing harm. ⚑ THIS IS WORLD-TIME AGAINST A CONTEST SURFACE: a thing you open inside an encounter, that advances OUTSIDE one, at a rate set by who came with you. ⚠️ If the project does not advance while the party is away, THAT IS THE BUG THIS FLOOR EXISTS TO FIND.
_openToErik: ⬜ ONE THING LEFT, AND IT IS A SINGLE SENTENCE WHEN HE WANTS IT: ⛔ WHAT THE MEASUREMENT SAYS. ⚠️ Nobody has read it out, so a player holding the controls holds an UNREAD VERDICT ABOUT THEIR OWN SPECIES and can look at it. ⚑ Everything else works whether the answer is yes, no, or 'the instrument was mis-calibrated by the Transition and has been measuring the wrong thing for four hundred years.'
_theAssayIs: ⛔ AUTHORED 2026-09-05 — `content/packs/valley/lore/the_assay.md`. ⚑ THE ASSAY MEASURES WHETHER WHAT GREW HERE CAN BE HANDED THE APPARATUS. Not whether we are good — whether we are READY. ⚠️ An assay is a test of ore: you measure the material to decide whether it is worth refining. ⛔ AND IT NEVER REPORTED. Nobody collected, so the test is not over and EVERYTHING SINCE HAS BEEN INSIDE IT — the Transition itself is a RESULT nobody has read out.
